examples.brief: launch page for an AI note-taking startup

ui.steal: The serif headline that breaks into italics mid line.
Objects laid out like pinned specimens, with a tiny label in the middle.
One calm sentence with the key words set in italic.
A plain index list of past work as the whole left column.
The inverted section: light type on deep color for one screen.
Navigation as giant type, with one word struck through.
The feature grid, to calm down with a serif and a paper tone.
Black and white photos cropped hard into a magazine grid.

art.steal: One specimen centred on the sheet, label in the bottom corner.
Lots of empty paper around a single small object.
The colour checker strip as a quiet divider.
Faded inks and handwritten labels for captions.

stitch.title: Specimen launch
stitch.note: A dark nav over an editorial serif hero, specimens as cards, the index list as proof, the menu as a footer.

parts.note: Pill nav and one call to action on the right.
Serif and italic headline next to one photo.
Each feature pinned like a specimen.
The index list, as the proof column.
Keep the grid, swap the icons for line drawings.
The menu set huge, as the last screen.

ui.steal: Arched frames that could hold a batik fill.
One big photo behind a short serif line.
The full bleed first screen with one button.
Three onboarding steps with one idea each.
Warm colour blocks behind each screen.
A plain checklist of what the first week holds.
A dark screen with one centred pattern.
Soft green cards with a single illustration.

art.steal: Megamendung cloud lines, like marbled paper.
Kawung circles as a repeating progress mark.
Deep indigo with copper line work.
Batik used as a brand frame, not a wallpaper.

ui.steal: Pale green morning light behind the balance.
Mint cards with the balance as the biggest thing.
A gauge that could become contour rings.
One clean home screen, nothing extra.
Charts in deep green with a glow.
Spending as a ring, with a list under it.
Big numbers on dark cards.
One loud accent colour for the main action.

art.steal: Contour lines as the chart grid.
Raised relief, to show where money piles up.
Soft map colours for categories.
Elevation labels as tiny amount labels.

ui.steal: Stat tiles kept in place while they wait for data.
Grey chart outlines as a preview of what comes.
A dark empty table with one quiet prompt.
One small card centred in a big calm space.
Bars drawn as ghosts, labelled sample data.
The first action as the only coloured button.
A friendly scene in the middle of the frame.
Search empty state with ready made suggestions.

art.steal: Chrome ripples for the empty chart area.
Mercury drops as loading dots.
Highlights, not colour, to show depth.
A cold silver palette with one warm accent.

ui.steal: Stacked heavy type on a deep green block.
The name set edge to edge in one colour.
Line drawings of beans around the hero.
A product page that reads like a tasting card.
Beans shown as round swatches in a row.
A serif headline over one warm photo.
Tins floating on white, shot from below.
A spaced out serif wordmark across the top.

art.steal: Squiggles and confetti as section dividers.
Primary colours on clean geometric parts.
Black and white stripes next to loud colour.
A poster grid with one tilted title.

stitch.title: Memphis roastery
stitch.note: A red wordmark hero, bags as cards from two shops, a dark green review band, a blue footer.

parts.note: Centred wordmark, cart on the right.
The name as the hero, edge to edge.
Bags on colour blocks, one per roast.
Bags with name and price under each.
A full blue footer with the name in caps.

examples.brief: Ramadan offers page for a grocery delivery app

ui.steal: Right to left layout with Arabic numerals done well.
Gold lantern art on a dark first screen.
Warm cream cards with crescent details.
A big countdown to iftar as the hero.
One clean timer card, lots of white.
Prayer times as a short list with icons.
Soft purple day cards in a grid.
Food and delivery tiles on a dark map.

art.steal: Camel and triangle rows as offer dividers.
Red, white and black bands for the offer tags.
Big diamond motifs as the badge on the best offer.
Narrow woven stripes as a progress bar.
